import polars as pl

NULL_VALUES = ["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null", "NULL", "None"]

def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    # Pre-clean placeholder strings across all columns to nulls
    cleaned = raw.with_columns(
        [
            pl.when(pl.col(c).is_in(NULL_VALUES))
            .then(None)
            .otherwise(pl.col(c))
            .alias(c)
            for c in raw.columns
        ]
    )

    return cleaned.select(
        [
            pl.col("receipt").str.to_uppercase().cast(pl.String).alias("order_id"),
            pl.col("lines.#").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("line_no"),
            pl.col("ts").str.to_datetime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", strict=False).dt.cast_time_unit("us").alias("sold_at"),
            pl.col("store.code").str.to_uppercase().cast(pl.String).alias("store"),
            pl.col("lines.sku").str.to_uppercase().cast(pl.String).alias("sku"),
            pl.col("lines.qty").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("qty"),
            pl.col("lines.unit").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2).alias("unit_price"),
            pl.col("lines.disc").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).fill_null(0.0).round(2).alias("discount"),
            pl.col("lines.total").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2).alias("line_total"),
        ]
    )
